Tesella Pod’s HQ is a magnet for wandering Aniimo. The folks who work here love Aniimo just as much as the students at Polaris Institute—see an Aniimo and they’ll reflexively pull out a can, the same way students reflexively pull out an Aniipod.

After a while, most Aniimo pick a feeder to twine with and stop roaming. But there’s one Morphling that refuses—no matter what—to choose a single, steady human partner. Even if someone takes it home, it’ll still turn up at Tesella Pod HQ the next day.

So people stopped fixating on twining with the Morphling and instead treated it like a close friend: eating, drinking, playing around, and spending the holidays together. And when it comes to changing shape, the Morphling really shows off. On the Harvest Festival, it turns into an apple, hides in a pile of fruit, and jumpscares someone with a “surprise.” On the Spooktacular Festival, it becomes a sparkling jack-o’-lantern, slyly waiting for the lucky soul who picks it up.

“A thousand-shapes Morphling is an Aniimo that bonds with the world,” said Ms. Amber, founder of Tesella Pod.

The Morphling found the phrase “bond with the world” fascinating. But the Astra hangs high in space—its world has four borders, utterly unlike the boundless Idyll.

It thought, “I should go see Idyll! That’s where I was born, too!”

Before leaving for Idyll, the Morphling decided it should say goodbye to the people at Tesella Pod. But when it came by again, the company was in the middle of a celebration. “Doesn’t feel like the right time to say goodbye,” it thought. So, like always, it joined the party and decided to go next time.

Next time, a female technician happened to make a beautiful plate of Aniimo-meal to feed it. “Ugh—saying goodbye now would totally kill the vibe!” So, like always, it finished the pretty meal and decided it would say it next time.

Next time, the time after next... it never seemed like the right moment. Maybe a young operator was crying over a breakup and needed the adorable Morphling to comfort them. Maybe a batch of new hires had just joined Tesella Pod and were building precious friendships with it. Either way, no day felt right—so every day became: “Ugh, next time for sure!”

...

And so, one morning—before the workday even began—the Morphling took off the mask that carried its memories and quietly set it down at Tesella Pod’s front door. With the mask removed, Astra faded from its memory, leaving only a warm, happy blur.

Free at last, the Morphling set out on its journey.

“After the trip is over, I’ll put it back on again!”

During the event, Pathfinders can participate in the Night Candy House and Night Perfume Making events to collect stickers, fill out the Night Journal, and claim parade rewards.
[Night Candy House]

1. Complete daily Parade quests to earn Night Candies, up to 3 per day. Candies can be saved up with no limits.
2. Spend Night Candies on the main event page to decorate the Candy House and receive a gift. After spending 30 Candies in total, the Candy House will be fully decorated.

[Night Perfume Making]
1. Aniimo companions will visit one after another during the event. Make a perfume for each visitor in the order they arrive. Aniimo that have already visited will remain available until the event ends.
2. Based on each visiting Aniimo’s preferences, choose 3 ingredients from those offered to make a perfume. If the fragrance meets the requirements, you can submit it to receive rewards and an Aniimo sticker. If it doesn’t meet the requirements, you cannot submit it.

[Night Journal]
1. Decorate the Candy House and make perfume for visitors to obtain corresponding Journal stickers. Collect enough stickers to claim the corresponding rewards.

1. Once the event begins, Polaris Institute will reveal this period’s mystery Aniimo silhouette.
2. The initial silhouette will only show the mystery Aniimo’s distinctive features, with the remaining parts hidden. Pathfinders can reveal the hidden parts by photographing Aniimo that share the same features as the mystery Aniimo.
3. Photograph an Aniimo matching the silhouette’s corresponding form and submit it to complete the research topic and claim the corresponding rewards. Successfully photographing before the full silhouette is revealed earns you bonus Aniimo Observation Rewards!

<Age Fifty>
I returned to the Boschi Nebbiosi, but our "old spot" was gone.
Tucker was gone too.
...
Everything had lost its color.
Even the once-noisy, off-key Hummins seemed to have vanished.
...
I stood at the entrance to the maze ruins, almost wishing a crowd of Witchins would make my head spin with their dreadful singing.
But all that remained was silence and desolation.
...
Twenty years ago, I couldn’t wait to say goodbye to my friends and set off for distant lands.
I wanted to escape the shame of my terrible singing.
I dreamed of having a beautiful voice of my own.
And now, as I look at this bottle of "Beautiful Voice Perfume," I miss those days of being surrounded by awful singing more than ever.
...
I lie here, unwilling to leave.
Everything I remember is gone. Only this place, no longer quite our old spot, is still here waiting for me...
No. Tucker is still out there too. He must be waiting for me somewhere.

 · Complete the Fire Companion Codex quest.
 · Take part in the Continuing Sparks mode.
 · Check in at the Sparkelf statue in Horizon Square (only once per day).
 2. Continuing Sparks mode details:
 · Each day, interact with friends to light up Sparks. Interactions include:
 ※ Chat: send messages to each other.
 ※ Party Up: form a team.
 ※ Gift: send gifts to each other.
 ※ Aniimo Exchange: exchange Aniimo.
 ※ Visit Home: visit each other.
 · After you light up a Spark, a Spark icon will appear next to your friend’s nickname. The number next to it shows how many days you and that friend have interacted during the event. Once you hit 5 days or more, the Spark icon will also level up.
 · The Spark icon will gray out after the daily server refresh at 04:00. Interact with your friends to light it up again.
 3. Event rewards:
 · When your personal total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, you can claim personal progress rewards.
 · When the server-wide total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, all players can claim server-wide progress rewards.
 · Special Notes:
 ※ The Sparkelf with the <style=Hint_BgL>Sparkling Mutation</style> (including the Basic Form and Prismana Form) has a sparkling outline effect, but no partial recolor effect.
 ※ The Sparkelf (Prismana Form) will be unavailable after the event ends. Please stay tuned for future official announcements."

Completing Nurture increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy. Capturing Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike, increasing the area’s Prismatic Energy.
· Each time Nurture increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 3% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
· Each time a Lucky Strike triggered while capturing an Aniimo increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 0.6% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
3. Every weekend, abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to gather in the designated area. Pathfinders can head there to explore and capture them.

June 28, Weather: Rainy
Today is the first day of our acquaintance. By "we," I don’t mean me and another person, but me and this notebook.
Starting today, this notebook will be my diary. As the saying goes, "Paper is more patient than people." It will witness every feeling I experience and every story I tell, sharing them with me along the way.

June 29
I have to admit, having a diary to confide in feels wonderful.
Today, I saw Iola. I wanted so badly to walk up to her and tell her how I feel,
but I don’t want to hear her turn me down.
So for now, I’ll just watch her from afar.

Amber: ...No, actually. Did you really think me that sentimental?
Astra today is nothing near as prosperous, nor as secure, as it looks on the surface. The crises are still very much with us.
...In other words, this is no era for indulging wealthy young people who want to run around doing as they please.
Every one of my decisions carries weight. I would never waste precious resources on my daughter’s whims.
I voted for her simply because I agree with her ideas.
“Wanting a little home to play and roam with Aniimo across the continent of Idyll”...
Honestly, that was my own original vision back when I first adventured across Idyll.
Secretary: Oh? I always thought...
Amber: ...that I was a total pragmatist from the very beginning? Not exactly.
It’s just that Polaris Institute talked me around. The future of Astra, the future of Pathfinders...
They were right. That’s why I started researching mass production of Aniipods, and thankfully, we succeeded.
Secretary: So GoGoHomes is really what you wanted to do all along, but never got the chance?
Amber: Yes. Driving your own little world across the continent of Idyll...
That was the dream I never got to fulfill. But looking at it now, Fannie has fulfilled it in my place.

1. According to observations by the Institute, Vein energy has been unusually active in some regions recently, causing unusual changes in the local ecosystem.
2. During the event, the chance of Stadio Nova Aniimo appearing will be greatly increased for the first 3 Nurture sessions conducted in the designated area each weekend. After Veinfruit is harvested, the amount of Prismatic Energy gained in the area will receive an additional 50% boost.
Completing Nurture increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy. Capturing Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike, increasing the area’s Prismatic Energy.
· Each time Nurture increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 3% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
· Each time a Lucky Strike triggered while capturing an Aniimo increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 0.6% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
3. Every weekend, abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to gather in the designated area. Pathfinders can head there to explore and capture them.
4. During the event, some special Prismana Aniimo will also be drawn by Vein energy and appear in designated areas for a limited time. See the event schedule below for the Prismana Aniimo appearing in each phase and their corresponding areas.

The writer, Armand, with his excellent storytelling skills, became a regular guest at these parties.

...
Bloomville’s perfumers were still working hard to cultivate the miraculous seedlings.
Although they had not yet found success, they had managed to develop a new species of flower, Cubbo’s rose.
The perfumers tasked Armand with delivering some Cubbo’s rose seeds to Princess Melloblum.
...
As the Seven Lethal Thorns dashed through Beardow Woods, Cubbo’s rose seeds were scattered throughout the forest.
Winter passed and spring arrived, and large patches of white blossoms carpeted the forest floor.
They helped the Cubbos drift to sleep.
Gradually, the once dangerous Beardow Woods became safe for the Budsquires as white blossoms covered the wilderness.

Chapter 4: Dance of Blissful Bloom
It was an ordinary spring day when the perfumers of the Florifragrant school guided the miraculous seedling’s vines in a spiral up the white tower.
Bloomville supported the Budsquire family,
and the Budsquires protected the people of Bloomville.
Watching all of this, Armand realized that he had found the true meaning of happiness.
...
These joyful events awakened Princess Melloblum’s long-dormant power.
Among the floating petals and permeating fragrance, she danced a powerful, yet gentle dance.
The dance bathed all the onlookers in happiness, and they all wished to be together forever.
...
It was during this dance that the miraculous seedling finally blossomed.
Perhaps the whitesnow rose is the most beautiful and potent flower in this world?
All the onlookers cheered, and from that day on, Beardow Woods received a new name and became Rosetower Woods.
Only, the whitesnow rose withered at the height of its beauty.

Unusual signs of Legendary Aniimo have begun appearing everywhere.
The Institute is recruiting Pathfinders to go investigate, and bring back valuable photos and complete the field notes.
Event Details
1. During the event, the Institute will unlock multiple investigation areas over time.
2. Each area has different investigation objectives and environmental features. Dispatch suitable Aniimo to explore them.
3. After completing an investigation, you can obtain the corresponding area rewards and may also receive an extra Chance Encounter Gift.
Investigation Rules
1. Each investigation requires at least 2 Aniimo. You must designate 1 as the Leader Aniimo before the investigation.
2. After the investigation is complete, you will receive base rewards according to the dispatched Aniimo.
Dispatching Aniimo meeting the area preference conditions increases your reward rating.
3. Prismana Form and Sparkling Aniimo can sense the residual energy of Legendary Aniimo, which will help speed up the investigation.

Chance Encounter Gifts
When passing through an area with Legendary Aniimo, something special might appear from their energy.
After completing an investigation, you also have a chance to receive 1 Chance Encounter Reward. One of the following rewards will be granted at random:
- <style=Q_5>Random Leader Aniimo Potential +1</style>
- Starcryst Essence x1
- Capaseme x5
- Vein Essence x1

1. According to Institute observations, Vein energy has recently become unusually active in certain areas, bringing special changes to the local ecosystems.
2. During the event, for your first 3 Nurtures each weekend in the designated areas, the chance of Nova Stage Aniimo appearing is greatly increased, and Prismatic Energy gained from picking Veinfruit is increased by an extra 50%. 
Nurturing increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy, and catching Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike that further increases it.
· Each Nurturing increases an area’s Prismatic Energy, and there’s a 3% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo. 
· Each time a Lucky Strike occurs while catching Aniimo, increasing a region’s Prismatic Energy, there’s a 0.6% chance a Prismana Flow will trigger, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo.
3. Every weekend, the abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to the designated areas for you to explore and catch.

<style=Hint_BgL>[Acquired Potential]</style> can be raised through Capability Awakening. Higher increases require more, rarer items.
The <style=Hint_BgL>sum of Innate Potential and Acquired Potential</style> cannot exceed <style=Hint_BgL>20</style>. Higher Potential results in greater stat increases as the Aniimo levels up.

1891484831:
This was once the White Plateau, second in elevation to Twister Peaks, its lands blanketed in deep snow.
Beardow Woods was the only path leading to the White Plateau.
Dangerous Cubbos staggered about, their threatening growls echoing around.
Budsquires shivered as they braved the bitter wind and snow to reach the White Plateau.
For here grew a marvelous flower that had the mysterious power to make Cubbos keep their distance.
Gradually, the people of Bloomville also discovered that white flower.
At first, the Bloomville folk and the Budsquires lived on opposite sides of the flower, leaving each other undisturbed.
Slowly, they began to communicate with each other and live together on the White Plateau.
As the Melloblum performed the Dance of Blissful Bloom, the white flower blossomed against the bitter cold and whirling snow.
It was called the "whitesnow rose"—a miracle on the snow.
The miracle of a beautiful flower blooming amid a harsh and unforgiving world.
And the miracle of the Bloomville folk and Budsquires living together and helping each other.
Where the whitesnow rose grows is a shared homeland of both the Bloomville people and the Budsquire family.

1. According to Institute observations, Vein energy has recently become unusually active in certain areas, bringing special changes to the local ecosystems.
2. During the event, for your first 3 Nurtures each weekend in the designated areas, the chance of Nova Stage Aniimo appearing is greatly increased, and Prismatic Energy gained from picking Veinfruit is increased by an extra 50%. 
Nurturing increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy, and catching Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike that further increases it.
· Each Nurturing increases an area’s Prismatic Energy, and there’s a 3% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo. 
· Each time a Lucky Strike occurs while catching Aniimo, increasing a region’s Prismatic Energy, there’s a 0.6% chance a Prismana Flow will trigger, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo.
3. Every weekend, the abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to the designated areas for you to explore and catch.

1913204117:
Chapter 1: Princess
Not long ago, the writer and nature lover Armand left Bloomville and ventured deep into the Beardow Woods.
There, he discovered the gentle yet powerful Princess Melloblum, and her six Budsquires.
Imagine his surprise at this discovery, because this area of the forest was known to be home to the ill-tempered Cubbo Family, who did not get along well with others, and tended to force their neighbors off their land.
Upon further observation, Armand noticed a flower seedling growing on the land where Princess Melloblum and her Budsquires lived.
It emitted a faint fragrance, reminiscent of snow, with a lingering scent of joy.
Armand noted that the Cubbo Family seemed reluctant to approach the seedling.
"Lucky," Armand thought, "that nature favors the beautiful."
...
Later, Armand realized that he, too, was blessed by fortune.
Because Budsquires happened to be the only family he could twine with.
After twining with them, he became the seventh Budsquire, devoted to Princess Melloblum.
...
From that day on, the tale of "Princess Melloblum and the Seven Budsquires" began to spread through Beardow Woods.
And Armand enjoyed an idyllic time living in the forest.

1. According to Institute observations, Vein energy has recently become unusually active in certain areas, bringing special changes to the local ecosystems.
2. During the event, for your first 3 Nurtures each weekend in the designated areas, the chance of Nova Stage Aniimo appearing is greatly increased, and Prismatic Energy gained from picking Veinfruit is increased by an extra 50%. 
Nurturing increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy, and catching Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike that further increases it.
· Each Nurturing increases an area’s Prismatic Energy, and there’s a 3% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo. 
· Each time a Lucky Strike occurs while catching Aniimo, increasing a region’s Prismatic Energy, there’s a 0.6% chance a Prismana Flow will trigger, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo.
3. Every weekend, the abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to the designated areas for you to explore and catch.
4. During the event, certain special Prismana Aniimo will also be drawn by the Vein energy and appear in designated areas for a limited time. See the event schedule below for details on which Prismana Forms appear in which areas at each stage.

1937621481:
The Recas didn’t like being called "Recas"—a title reserved for the strongest of the Bonesky clan. He could never defeat the Icho, not even come close.
Once an ordinary, naive Bonesky, he wandered out of his ice cave one day and got lost, eventually encountering the Icho. He sensed the power radiating from the Icho and grew wary, but the Icho beckoned him over. Having lost his rival, the Icho was lonely and asked, "Little one, do you want to grow stronger?"
Driven by his instinct to challenge the powerful, the Bonesky gave a simple, resolute answer. From that day, the Icho trained him like a master, aiming to raise a worthy opponent. Soon, he grew into a Fenrier.
"Master Icho, how strong must I become?"
"Only more powerful than yesterday. Till you become a Recas and defeat me."
He soon became the Bonesky clan’s mightiest and earned the name Recas, yet he still could not best the Icho. One day, the Icho decided to leave, saying he was no longer the strongest. The Recas couldn’t believe anyone but his future self could surpass the Icho.
"That person comes from beyond our world."
"Now I’m off to test myself in the wider world."
The Recas didn’t understand—only that this "person" had defeated the Icho. So he honed his will, aiming to someday overcome both the Icho and that "person."
Then he became a Glynsera, but he never met "that person."
Then you came along. The moment you defeated the Recas, he finally came to understand.
"I’ve met a person of my own."
"I’ve also seen a bigger world."

1942515667: The Story of the Bloom Festival
1942586507:
When she was young, Baboni would always ask her mentor Avetine why the legendary perfume formula was called "Golden Wish" and why its main ingredient was named "Golden Answer." Avetine would tell her the story of Haidt, the founding perfumer.
————
Haidt was a genius perfumer, and also a strange one.
She always lived in her own world. Perfumery was her way of speaking to the world, and fragrance was the world’s response.
She could hear others, yet never quite understood them.
It was as if her ears caught the words, but her heart could not truly listen.
In search of inspiration, Haidt came to Blitzwood, where she was struck by lightning and fell unconscious.
After waking up, she found herself in a cave beneath a Blitz Tree. She was brought there by a Blazen. A young, clueless Bolty was also there.
Haidt could not understand them.
Then the Blazen motioned for her to touch its bristling tail.
A faint yet layered current of electricity flowed through her.
Haidt withdrew her hand instinctively, but a word echoed in her heart:
Concern.
She could not understand the word, yet for the first time she felt the meaning of concern.
Injured and touched by this feeling, Haidt stayed—living with the Blazen and its cub.
They grew from strangers into family.
Haidt would often go with the Blazen to the Blitz Tree.
The Blazen would send its wishes to the World of Wonders through electric currents, and would also carry Haidt’s voice into the world.
The thunder rolled on as usual, but nothing ever came of it.
The little Bolty was not interested in this routine, as if it did not believe in the World of Wonders at all.
So the days passed on.
Until one day, the Blazen left—perhaps to the World of Wonders.
Haidt went to the Blitz Tree one last time.
She could not generate electricity, but she cried out from the very bottom of her heart.
A peal of thunder sounded, and a branch fell—like a reply from a distant friend.
————
Young Baboni was deeply drawn to Haidt’s amazing story. She too longed to see that World of Wonders.
Each time, Avetine would shake her head gently and call Baboni her "silly little apprentice."
Baboni grew frustrated.
She began to feel that perhaps Avetine didn’t really like her, especially when Avetine mentioned that once Baboni finished her studies, she would leave for a long journey. Baboni felt sad and was convinced that she just couldn’t wait to leave her foolish apprentice.
It was only when she crafted Golden Wish that Baboni understood—what Avetine truly wished was for Baboni to grow into an apprentice she could trust and finally let go, and that Haidt had not named that fallen branch Golden Answer because the branch itself was extraordinary.
Perhaps that thunder was not truly a reply from her friend Blazen.
But the bond they once shared would never fade.

5. Once your accumulated Investigation Points reach the specified requirements, you can claim the corresponding milestone rewards.

During the event, Pathfinders can participate in the Night Candy House and Night Perfume Making events to collect stickers, fill out the Night Journal, and claim parade rewards.
[Night Candy House]

1. Complete daily Parade quests to earn Night Candies, up to 3 per day. Candies can be saved up with no limits.
2. Spend Night Candies on the main event page to decorate the Candy House and receive a gift. After spending 30 Candies in total, the Candy House will be fully decorated.

[Night Perfume Making]
1. Aniimo companions will visit one after another during the event. Make a perfume for each visitor in the order they arrive. Aniimo that have already visited will remain available until the event ends.
2. Based on each visiting Aniimo’s preferences, choose 3 ingredients from those offered to make a perfume. If the fragrance meets the requirements, you can submit it to receive rewards and an Aniimo sticker. If it doesn’t meet the requirements, you cannot submit it.

[Night Journal]
1. Decorate the Candy House and make perfume for visitors to obtain corresponding Journal stickers. Collect enough stickers to claim the corresponding rewards.

1965811091:
Day One
I’ve sailed for many years, but never have I faced such a storm surge.
The waves threw me onto the beach like flotsam—what a disgrace to an old sailor like me.
Fortunately, there is enough wild fruit and fresh water near the beach so I don’t need to worry about starving.
I’ll just wait for the storm to die down and then set sail again.

Day Four
I built a shelter to keep me out of the rain—it looks sturdy enough.
I was shocked to see an Echoback stranded on the beach.
It looks young—perhaps the storm messed with its echolocation.
I’ll try to take it back home once the storm stops.

Day Seven
Another shelter destroyed by the storm... That makes three now. The storm shows no sign of stopping.
More and more Echobacks are getting stranded. It’s strange since they almost never get lost at sea.
I can’t even remember how many times their singing has guided me out of storms.
Now we’re trapped on this beach together, and there’s nothing I can do to help them but listen to their wailing all day long in the pouring rain.
I pray to you, Aeolus.
Please help us through the storm and guide us home safely.

Day Ten
I’ve lost another shelter. I’m too tired to build more.
Almighty Aeolus, am I going to die in this foreign land’s endless storm?

Day Eleven
This has to be the most unbelievable scene I’ve witnessed in my entire life.
An enormous Echoback showed up in the storm and guided his struggling brothers and sisters back into the depths of the sea, one by one.
His powerful singing even drowned out the howling winds and thunder. He just kept singing until all the stranded Echobacks found their way back.
Watching his figure swimming through the waves, I realized that no storm lasts forever. 
Just like every storm I’ve been through, they always end with blue skies.

Day Fifteen
The storm has finally stopped.
I didn’t fail my reputation as an old sailor, just like the Echoback didn’t fail his brothers and sisters.
He brought them all back to the sea, but stayed behind... forever, on this shore.
The raft I made was too small to tow him, so I could only carve my journal into this stone.
I know that his bones will stand here for a very long time.

May his life outlast even this story.
May all sailors finally see their blue skies.

1991243920:
My great-grandfather was a musician. In the era when the world lost its color, he inspired people with music.
But music that heals the soul cannot defeat hunger.
He collapsed.
He only came around after a perfumer fed him sweet nectar.
Later, unable to refuse her request, he inherited her legacy and became a perfumer himself.
He felt trapped in a place without wind.
...
Long after, he decided he had had enough and ran all the way to a cliff.
Back then, Argent Strait was still colorless, untouched by the Guardian’s grace like Bloomville.
Crescendo Cliff was ravaged by endless gales, and was known as the "Deadland of a Thousand Winds."
Yet in this deadland, my great-grandfather met some Chirpis singing in the wind.
So they sang loudly together... Even the wind couldn’t take their souls.
They were free.
They sang of freedom.
...
Years later, the Guardian returned green to the land, and Argent Strait revived.
On Crescendo Cliff, my great-grandfather twined with a Chirpi, flying and singing in the fresh wind.
This song gave birth to the Bell of Freedom.
It brought freedom, and a great wind leading to distant places.
...
My great-grandfather passed the perfumer’s legacy to my grandmother.
He was truly free.
They say he rode the great wind to where he wanted to go.
I envy him.
...
If only Flutternyms could fly across the sea.
My partner and I have always thought so.
If only there was a great wind leading far away.
I think, riding that wind, we could find freedom.
...
Now, the wind is here.

2. Pathfinders must follow the investigation list and catch the corresponding Aniimo to help the Institute complete its ecological investigation and earn Investigation Points.
3. Each target Aniimo only grants points the first time its investigation is completed. Catching the same target again will not grant additional points.
4. Please pay close attention to Aniimo forms. Only catching an Aniimo in the same form as listed on the investigation list will complete the corresponding investigation.
5. Once your accumulated Investigation Points reach the specified requirements, you can claim the corresponding milestone rewards.
6. If the investigation target is an Aniimo the Pathfinder has not yet registered in the Aniilog, the points earned for completing its investigation for the first time will be doubled.

1. During the event, you can get Sparks through the following ways:
· Complete the Fire Companion Codex quest.
· Take part in the Continuing Sparks mode.
· Check in at the Co-Raise Sprite "Little Fire Spirit" statue in Horizon Square (only once per day).
2. Continuing Sparks mode details:
· Each day, interact with friends to light up Sparks. Interactions include:
※ Chat: send messages to each other.
※ Party Up: form a team.
※ Gift: send gifts to each other.
※ Aniimo Exchange: exchange Aniimo.
※ Visit Home: visit each other.
· After you light up a Spark, a Spark icon will appear next to your friend’s nickname. The number next to it shows how many days you and that friend have interacted during the event. Once you hit 5 days or more, the Spark icon will also level up.
· The Spark icon will gray out after the daily server refresh at 04:00. Interact with your friends to light it up again.
3. Event rewards:
· When your personal total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, you can claim personal progress rewards.
· When the server-wide total number of Sparks reaches the required amount, all players can claim server-wide progress rewards.
· Special Notes:
※ The Co-Raise Sprite "Little Fire Spirit" with the <style=Hint_BgL>Sparkling Mutation</style> (including the Basic Form and Prismana Form) has a sparkling outline effect, but no partial recolor effect.
※ The Co-Raise Sprite "Little Fire Spirit" (Prismana Form) will be unavailable after the event ends. Please stay tuned for future official announcements.

Completing Nurture increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy. Capturing Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike, increasing the area’s Prismatic Energy.

2027377771:
Pathfinder, welcome to this issue of the Companion Handbook! This issue’s featured Aniimo is <color=#da8000>Hypnyto</color>!
During your adventures out in the world, complete Companion Handbook quests, raise your Companion Handbook level, and earn superb Companion Handbook rewards!

Companion Handbook Editions
The Companion Handbook’s level progress rewards are divided into the Standard Edition and Advanced Edition. The Advanced Edition requires you to unlock the Advanced Companion Handbook. Rewards include 1 <color=#da8000>Prismana Hypnyto</color> with Perfect Potential, a <color=#da8000>Hypnyto Soul (an item used to evolve Hypnyto)</color>, and a range of other rewards. It also grants a special perk: More Aniimo storage boxes. The Advanced Edition adds 5 Aniimo storage boxes, while the Collector’s Edition adds 10. These capacity bonuses do not stack; whichever edition you activate last takes priority.
Unlocking the Collector’s Companion Handbook grants additional rewards and perks immediately on top of the Advanced Companion Handbook.

Quests and Companion Handbook EXP
Quests are divided into weekly quests and seasonal quests. Each quest can only be completed once, and there is no weekly EXP limit.
Weekly quests refresh every Monday at 04:00, with progress resetting each week. New Seasonal Quests are added to the quest pool every Monday and stay available for the rest of the season. Newly added quests remain locked until you finish prerequisite quests in their questline. All quests end when the current Companion Handbook ends.
Companion Handbook EXP can also be obtained from Institute Guide - Daily Activity.
Once the Companion Handbook passes Lv. 100, it switches to a repeating reward cycle that caps out at Lv. 1000.

Gift Details
You can send a gift to friends who meet the required Affinity and have not yet unlocked the Advanced or Collector’s Companion Handbook. They will receive 1 item that can activate either the Advanced or Collector’s Companion Handbook.

Rerun Details
The Prismana Aniimo Egg from this season’s Companion Handbook will return in Season 3, and will be obtainable through Home-related gameplay.

6. Pathfinders can complete the event by photographing their own Aniimo, other players’ Aniimo, or wild Aniimo on the continent of Idyll.

1. Once the event begins, Polaris Institute will reveal this period’s mystery Aniimo silhouette.

3. Photograph an Aniimo matching the silhouette’s corresponding form and submit it to complete the research topic and claim the corresponding rewards. Successfully photographing before the full silhouette is revealed earns you bonus Aniimo Observation Rewards!
4. Pathfinders can also select photos from their existing album that meet the topic requirements for submission. If a photo contains this period’s mystery Aniimo, it counts toward event completion too.
5. Pay attention to Aniimo forms — only photos where the submitted Aniimo matches the mystery Aniimo’s exact form will count toward event completion.
6. Pathfinders can complete the event by photographing their own Aniimo, other players’ Aniimo, or wild Aniimo on the continent of Idyll.
7. Aniimo in the Holo-Battle Sim are holographic projections, and Aniimo found in Sanctums are bound by ancient seals. Photos taken in these two locations cannot be recognized or submitted.

1. According to Institute observations, Vein energy has recently become unusually active in certain areas, bringing special changes to the local ecosystems.
2. During the event, for your first 3 Nurtures each weekend in the designated areas, the chance of Nova Stage Aniimo appearing is greatly increased, and Prismatic Energy gained from picking Veinfruit is increased by an extra 50%. 
Nurturing increases the current area’s Prismatic Energy, and catching Aniimo also has a chance to trigger a Lucky Strike that further increases it.
· Each Nurturing increases an area’s Prismatic Energy, and there’s a 3% chance to trigger a Prismana Flow, drawing out that area’s Prismana Aniimo.

4. Please pay close attention to Aniimo forms. Only catching an Aniimo in the same form as listed on the investigation list will count toward the corresponding investigation.
5. Once your accumulated Investigation Points reach the specified requirements, you can claim the corresponding milestone rewards.
6. If the investigation target is an Aniimo you haven’t yet registered in the Aniilog, the points earned for completing its investigation for the first time will be doubled.

2. Pathfinders must follow the investigation list and catch the corresponding Aniimo to help the Institute complete its ecological investigation and earn Investigation Points.
3. Each target Aniimo only grants points the first time its investigation is completed. Catching the same target again will not grant additional points.
4. Please pay close attention to Aniimo forms. Only catching an Aniimo in the same form as listed on the investigation list will complete the corresponding investigation.
5. Once your accumulated Investigation Points reach the specified requirements, you can claim the corresponding milestone rewards.
6. If the investigation target is an Aniimo the Pathfinder has not yet registered in the Aniilog, the points earned for completing its investigation for the first time will be doubled.

2099679250:
The First Stop: Bloom Festival
At my first stop in Bloomville, I was lucky enough to participate in the famous Bloom Festival.
A three-day rain of flowers began on the first day of the festival; it was splendid and almost unreal.
The flowers bloomed in the breeze, with petals floating down onto my shoulders and hair, bringing a subtle fragrance. I felt like I was in a fairytale...

The Second Stop: Irisalis
After the festival, I had the privilege of visiting Irisalis, the legendary Aniimo and guardian of Bloomville.
She stood among the flowers, looking intimidating, although the rain of flowers made her a little pale.
According to the locals, she would fall asleep after a show and become vigorous again before the next one.
Like flowers, the cycle of life never stops.
Regrettably, Somniwing, the other powerful Aniimo, didn’t show up. I hope to have the honor of meeting her the next time I come to Bloomville.

The Third Stop: The Sea of Flowers
Today, I visited the Sea of Flowers and tried Bloomville’s special perfume-making art.
The rain of flowers dropped by Irisalis was still ongoing. People picked flowers of different colors and fed them to Dewies. These lovely creatures could transform floral scents into fragrant incense.
I tried the experience myself; the fluffy Dewy in my palm felt so nice and made me realize that mankind and Aniimo can live together in such harmony in Idyll.
I managed to craft a bottle of perfume myself, and after a light sniff, a fresh and delicate fragrance filled my mind, as if all my worries and fatigue were washed away...
Have you ever had such a healing journey?

2101900361:
Just like Cress, Ranka is descended from Bloomville’s night watchers.
But as Irelia restored all the colors to the land, peace settled in, and the night watchers were no longer needed.
People grew eager to explore new lands, searching for ingredients to craft exquisite perfumes.
From this curiosity arose Bloomville’s floral school, devoted to seeking and planting rare flowers—the first perfumery tradition of the town.
Ranka’s ancestor was among its earliest practitioners.
————
Flareburst flowers bloom on the ridgeback trees, radiant symbols of fighting spirit, and were once the very prize the night watchers pursued.
Unlike Cress’s warrior-descended ancestor, Ranka’s forebear carried no rusty iron sword steeped in glory.
Yet he shared the Emberpup’s ambition, climbing toward the highest peaks side by side.
Ever since, perfumers of this lineage have grown alongside their Emberpup companions.
They see flareburst flowers as their goal and regard "true battles" as nourishment on their path of adventure.
————
Ranka, however, did not long for the mightiest path. Even as a perfumer, he was inclined toward idleness.
Perhaps the blood of the night watchers had thinned.
Perhaps it was because his mother once chose the path over him.
Whatever the reason, he preferred lying still in a sunlit meadow of blossoms, breathing in the scents of the flowers.
That was until one day, when the Emberpup he grew up with also left to embark on its own adventure, and a ripple stirred in his heart... soon settling back into calm.
That longing for the path, and that weariness of it, together shaped the Ranka we know today.
And so, whenever he calls himself a "legendary perfumer," it feels both proud and tired.

· Each time Nurture increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 3% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
· Each time a Lucky Strike triggered while capturing an Aniimo increases the area’s Prismatic Energy, there is a 0.6% chance of triggering a Prismana Flow, causing local Prismana Aniimo to appear.
3. Every weekend, abundant Vein energy will also draw large numbers of Aniimo to gather in the designated area. Pathfinders can head there to explore and capture them.

(Once the Tracing the Trail event ends, Irisalis Petals will no longer be available through that event.)

1. Story
Obtain by clearing the following Story chapters: Ceremony Preparations, The Unbegun Ceremony, Colorful Fragrance, The Land of Dancing Illusions, The Land where Dreams Come True, Ancient Sacred Fragrance, Rainbow of the Ground, and A New Journey.

2. Journey Quests
Obtain by clearing the following Journey Quests: The Legend of Mist and Light, The Legend of Echoback Landing, The Legend of Flowers and Thorns, The Legend of the Land of Falling Stars, The Legend of Thousand-Fang Ridge, The Legend of the Land of Lightning and Thunder, The Legend of Helmuts and Helgons, The Legend of the Bell of Freedom, The Legend of the Berylline Vale, and The Legend of Driftwise Meadow.

3. Open-World Gathering
Follow Irelia’s footsteps and gather Irisalis Petals across Breezy Plains.

4. First Alpha Clear
Get them upon your first victory over the Alpha in each area of Breezy Plains.

5. Elite Pathfinder Challenge
Obtain by defeating the following elite Pathfinders in Breezy Plains or Astra: Senior Wally, Senior Jilly, Senior Loulla, Senior Aster, Senior Wendell, Senior Cecelia, and Lita.

6. Branch Nurturing
Obtain by infusing energy into the Breezy Plains Branch and claiming its growth milestone rewards.

7. Breezy Plains Silver Badges
Obtain by claiming Silver Badges from each area in Breezy Plains.

8. Aniimo Research
Unlock the Nova Stage Aniimo Index entries for each Family in your Aniilog, complete the research topic Collect Prismana Form, and claim the corresponding rewards.

9. Tracing the Trail
Obtain from the limited-time event Tracing the Trail. Once the event ends, Irisalis Petals will no longer be available through this method.

2116933508:
Tesella Pod’s HQ is a magnet for wandering Aniimo. The folks who work here love Aniimo just as much as the students at Polaris Institute—see an Aniimo and they’ll reflexively pull out a can, the same way students reflexively pull out an Aniipod.

After a while, most Aniimo pick a feeder to twine with and stop roaming. But there’s one Morphling that refuses—no matter what—to choose a single, steady human partner. Even if someone takes it home, it’ll still turn up at Tesella Pod HQ the next day.

So people stopped fixating on twining with the Morphling and instead treated it like a close friend: eating, drinking, playing around, and spending the holidays together. And when it comes to changing shape, the Morphling really shows off. On the Harvest Festival, it turns into an apple, hides in a pile of fruit, and jumpscares someone with a “surprise.” On the Spooktacular Festival, it becomes a sparkling jack-o’-lantern, slyly waiting for the lucky soul who picks it up.

“A thousand-shapes Morphling is an Aniimo that bonds with the world,” said Ms. Amber, founder of Tesella Pod.

The Morphling found the phrase “bond with the world” fascinating. But the Astra hangs high in space—its world has four borders, utterly unlike the boundless Idyll.

It thought, “I should go see Idyll! That’s where I was born, too!”

Before leaving for Idyll, the Morphling decided it should say goodbye to the people at Tesella Pod. But when it came by again, the company was in the middle of a celebration. “Doesn’t feel like the right time to say goodbye,” it thought. So, like always, it joined the party and decided to go next time.

Next time, a female technician happened to make a beautiful plate of Aniimo-meal to feed it. “Ugh—saying goodbye now would totally kill the vibe!” So, like always, it finished the pretty meal and decided it would say it next time.

Next time, the time after next... it never seemed like the right moment. Maybe a young operator was crying over a breakup and needed the adorable Morphling to comfort them. Maybe a batch of new hires had just joined Tesella Pod and were building precious friendships with it. Either way, no day felt right—so every day became: “Ugh, next time for sure!”

...

And so, one morning—before the workday even began—the Morphling took off the mask that carried its memories and quietly set it down at Tesella Pod’s front door. With the mask removed, Astra faded from its memory, leaving only a warm, happy blur.

Free at last, the Morphling set out on its journey.

“After the trip is over, I’ll put it back on again!”

July 5th
I've ignored you for nearly a week, but nothing has happened here.
Perhaps I should introduce myself to you, my diary. My name is Lycus, and my little brother—a little Emberpup—is called Remy.
I was born on the Grassland, with no friends. The Nimbi flocks always avoid me,
but at least the village elders and my parents are willing to chat with me... and you, my diary.

July 15th
Today was the day to go home and see my parents.
My parents showed a hint of a smile when they saw me. They care for me deeply, but there's always something hidden behind their words.
That night, when I went to wash my hands, I overheard their conversation: "We should tell him the truth. He'll find out sooner or later."
The truth? I don't know what they're referring to, but an inexplicable unease welled up in my Heart.
I returned to my room, saw the diary on the desk, opened a page, and poured this unease onto paper.

July 27th
My parents finally told me the "truth."
It turns out that besides my "adoptive parents" here and my "wolf mother," I have other "parents."
Apparently, they were the parents who gave birth to me.
They seem to have gone to Apeiro... and I'm beginning to have new ideas.

...Praise the guidance of the wind.
Praise Aeolus, the Aeon who rules and protects the Zephyr Coast.
...
With beautiful wings and razor-sharp claws, soaring through the skies.
...
Praise the great and benevolent Aeon, master of gale, time, and the cycles of life.
Its gaze watches over every corner of the Zephyr Coast.
The Grasslands, the ocean, the blazing fire, and that most wondrous of places.
Its power flows through the Veins, and the Veins answer its call.
...
It bestowed the power of Lumin upon the Aniimo, allowing them to grow.
And those Aniimo granted its power shall grow into a form beyond compare.
These are the Guardians.
The Guardians come from this land, protect this land, and love this land.
The Aeon and the Veins grant them strength, and even the Flow bends to their will.
...
Thus, three offerings are made in its honor.
May the fragrance of the flowers bloom forever, may the song of the tides ring out forever, may the dancing flames blaze forever.
May the rhythm of the wind remain free beneath this eternal turning of time.
